item.tib: 'od zer 'khyil ba'i bdud rtsi sman gyi ting 'dzin
item.coloph: gnyis pa bkra shis nyin zhag rin po che'i gling la phyin pa lta bu'i 'phro 'du bkra shis rgyan gyi mthal (mtha') bsdu ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ mkhas grub la las btang bsnyoms (snyoms) tshul du byas/ stong gis zab don ma rtogs bka' lung slad (bslad) / g.yung drung tshul khrims bdag kyang nges don snying po ma mjal yang / kun rdzob bsda (brda) la cung zad sbyang (sbyangs) pa'i mthus/ gzhung dang dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ 'di byas dge ba 'gro kun bla med bsngo//
